name: edit-diagnostics
description: After Claude edits a file, runs the repo's own approved checks and gives the model a short, deduplicated list of what they report.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the mod on for new sessions. /edit-diagnostics on|off overrides it for a session.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: tool: run checks after each edit and add the report to that edit's result. batch: run once after a response's tool calls, through the PostToolBatch hook (skipped on some machines; see README).

timeoutMs.title: Per-check timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Longest a single check may run, 500 to 30000.

batchTimeoutMs.title: Per-run time budget (ms)
batchTimeoutMs.description: Total time all checks of one run may take, 1000 to 30000.
